# viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Block Storage volume backup policy, which takes volume backups on a schedule. Deleting a policy detaches it from its volumes, so set `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` on a policy in use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Back up every volume that uses the policy every 2 days, from the first
# execution on.
resource "viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy" "periodic" {
  name        = "example-periodic"
  description = "Backup every 2 days"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  status      = "enabled"
  retention   = 7

  schedule = {
    execution_strategy = "periodic"
    frequency          = 2
    frequency_unit     = "day"
    first_execution    = "2030-01-01T02:00:00Z"
  }
}

# Back up on the 1st and the 15th of each month at 02:00 UTC.
resource "viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy" "monthly" {
  name   = "example-monthly"
  region = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  status = "enabled"

  schedule = {
    execution_strategy = "days_of_month"
    days_of_month      = [1, 15]
    time               = "02:00"
  }

  # Deleting a policy that volumes use removes it from those volumes.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Backup policy name, 1 to 100 characters.
- `region` (Attributes) Project region of the backup policy. Changing it replaces the backup policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `schedule` (Attributes) When the policy takes backups. With `periodic`, set `frequency`, `frequency_unit`, and `first_execution`. With `days_of_month`, set `days_of_month` and `time`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `status` (String) Policy status: enabled or disabled. A disabled policy takes no backups.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Backup policy description, up to 255 characters. Omitting it preserves the current value. An empty string clears it.
- `retention` (Number) Number of backups that the policy keeps for each volume, from 1 to 65535. Omitting it at creation keeps 1. Omitting it later preserves the current value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Backup policy ID (UUID).
- `last_execution` (String) Time of the latest backup run (RFC3339). Null before the first run.
- `next_execution` (String) Time of the next backup (RFC3339). Null when none is planned.
- `state` (String) State of the latest backup run: ready, running, done, or fail.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC3339).
- `volume_count` (Number) Number of volumes that use the policy.

<a id="nestedatt--region"></a>
### Nested Schema for `region`

Required:

- `name` (String) Region name.


<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `execution_strategy` (String) Schedule type: periodic or days_of_month.

Optional:

- `days_of_month` (Set of Number) Days of the month (1 to 31) on which the policy takes a backup. Required with `days_of_month`, not allowed with `periodic`.
- `first_execution` (String) Time of the first backup (RFC 3339), on the hour and in the future at creation. Required with `periodic`, not allowed with `days_of_month`.
- `frequency` (Number) Number of frequency units between two backups, from 1 to 1000. Required with `periodic`, not allowed with `days_of_month`.
- `frequency_unit` (String) Unit of `frequency`: day, week, or month. Required with `periodic`, not allowed with `days_of_month`.
- `time` (String) Time of day in UTC at which the policy takes a backup, as HH:MM or HH:MM:SS. Required with `days_of_month`, not allowed with `periodic`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_volume_backup_policy.periodic 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
